dimensions.note: No credentials are accepted, logged, or persisted.
Both methods emit structured entry and completion logs containing only the safe review ID.
Schema, integrity, invocation, chronology, freshness, and authority failures throw before either resource write.
Tests cover valid output, malformed strict contracts, injection-like input, determinism, tampering, stale evidence, authority escalation, and no-side-effect persistence.
Pure transformations are deterministic for fixed inputs and time; repeated methods target stable spec-prefixed instance names and have no external side effects.
The model makes no network or provider API call.
The model creates no workspace, file, process, connection, or external resource.
README and tests use synthetic/example identifiers and disclose the recommendation-only boundary.
All object schemas are strict; duplicate identifiers, constraints, and gates are rejected; writes conform 1:1 to their resource schemas.
Both immutable audit resources explicitly declare infinite lifetime and ten-version retention.
This is a bounded prepare/validate pipeline, not an external CRUD lifecycle.
Neither method mutates an external system.
request-<safe-id> and review-<safe-id> cannot collide across the two specs.
The transformations do not read stored state.
This is the initial unpublished standalone version.
